ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white) distribution concentrated primarily on the distal lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches are localized at the lateral extremities of both lobes; dense speckling transitions toward a solid dark central median; two distinct circular white focal spots are visible flanking the central notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a narrow vertex; estimated acute angle of approximately 30 degrees relative to the horizontal plane of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; a notable larger indentation/notch is present on the upper margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in thickened, textured rounded ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixels at the terminal ends of both lobes indicating barnacle colonization; two isolated high-contrast white circular spots located in the mid-fluke region near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive indentation or missing tissue segment on the upper-left trailing edge; heavy calcified-type accumulations (barnacles) on the outer lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric pigment distribution where the right lobe exhibits a more consolidated white patch compared to the more granular speckling on the left lobe.
